guardian_intro: Welcome, traveller. I am the Cave Guardian.
Beneath this hall lie the lost scrolls of Requirements Engineering.
Each scroll holds a lesson, sealed behind a challenge.
Solve the challenges, descend deeper, and master the craft.
guardian_returning: Back so soon, young analyst? Good.
guardian_exhausted: You have completed every scroll I have prepared.
Return another day — more arrive from the surface each week.
